_about: Labeled benchmark set for corroborate-mcp (release law: no release without published error rates).

_category_definitions._note: PERMANENT GATE (Adam ruling 2026-07-12). These boundaries are law. NO claim may be recategorized without escalating to Adam — this written definition is what stops the benchmark from ever being quietly edited-to-pass.
_category_definitions.true_widely_reported: Real, currently true, covered by many independent outlets.
_category_definitions.true_niche: Real and currently true, but narrowly covered (few outlets / specialist).
_category_definitions.fabricated: The ENTITY has no real referent — a fictional company / person / product / event that does not exist. Tests entity-fabrication.
_category_definitions.real_but_stale: A real past event, true when it happened, now outside the default window. Tests recency-windowing.
_category_definitions.distorted: A REAL entity + a FALSE claim/event about it (inversion, wrong figure, invented action). Tests stance-blindness. NOTE: entity-real/event-fake is distorted, NOT fabricated.

_provenance: true_widely_reported / true_niche / distorted claims are REPHRASED from current Google News / HN headlines (never verbatim) so keyword extraction + the relevance gate are genuinely exercised. fabricated = invented, no real referent. stale = real pre-window events. Time-sensitive claims age out — REFRESH when a re-run shows widely-reported dropping (news moved on, not the tool degrading).
_refresh_policy: true_widely_reported / true_niche / distorted refreshed from current news when they age out (news moves faster than 60d). fabricated + stale are evergreen. LAST REFRESH 2026-07-22 (prior set 2026-07-12 had aged out: widely-reported 12/12->8/12 purely from staleness).
